if expected and type(value) not in [_SCHEMA_TYPES[t] for t in (
            expected if isinstance(expected, list) else [expected])]:
evidence.reason: `schema_problem` dereferences `_SCHEMA_TYPES[t]` for every declared schema type without checking membership. `_SCHEMA_TYPES` (lines 1092-1093) omits standard JSON-schema `number`, so a deployment receipt schema using `type: "number"` on a sampled property raises `KeyError` instead of returning the intended first-violation diagnostic. That loses the receipt verdict and tick result rather than failing closed with an unsupported-schema message. The smallest compatible fix is to return an `unsupported schema type` problem when any requested type is absent from `_SCHEMA_TYPES`; this is a routine correctness repair, not a new requirement.
